rationale: ADR 0029 sizing law re-derived at 302 of 336 cards (89.9%): capacity must hold the measured population below 80% and one measured peak day (25 cards) below 90%, which needs 378 slots. Slots are max_parts x 56, so max_parts 6 -> 7 gives 392 (77.0% now, 83.4% after a peak day). Aggregates stay files x per-file.

The part surface is the same raise seen from the projection side: max_parts 6 -> 7 is the only free parameter, because a full 56-card part is 63 of 80 health lines and 57 cards would be exactly 80.0%. Both aggregate bands stay files x per-file.
